# Ghastly Guide

Ghastly Guide is a sourced release calendar for horror movies, television, video games, tabletop games, comics, and books.

- Calendar: https://ghastlyguide.com/
- Movies: https://ghastlyguide.com/movies
- Shows: https://ghastlyguide.com/shows
- Video games: https://ghastlyguide.com/games
- Tabletop games: https://ghastlyguide.com/tabletop
- Comics: https://ghastlyguide.com/comics
- Books: https://ghastlyguide.com/books
- Source policy: https://ghastlyguide.com/sources
- About and corrections policy: https://ghastlyguide.com/about
- Contact and release suggestions: https://ghastlyguide.com/contact
- RSS: https://ghastlyguide.com/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://ghastlyguide.com/sitemap.xml

Calendar month pages use `/calendar/YYYY/MM`. Individual release pages use `/releases/ID/title-slug` and provide the release date, medium, creator or publisher, platform or format, region, source confidence, last verification date, and public evidence link when available.

Dates retain their announced precision: a year-only or month-only date is not presented as an exact day. Official sources outrank licensed partners, reference databases, and editorial verification when records conflict.
